name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull to refresh
description: The mobile pull-down gesture for refreshing a list: an elastic indicator, a spinner while it works, and a visible Refresh button for everyone else.
docs: Give the component a height: the list scrolls inside it, is reachable by keyboard, and listLabel names it. onRefresh returns the promise of the work; the spinner stays until it settles. Only touch input starts a pull, so wheels and desktop scrolling are untouched, and the Refresh button in the bar runs the same handler. The scroller sets overscroll-behavior so the browser's own refresh does not fight it. Letting go early, or taking the finger back above where it began, cancels the pull.
